page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.xlarge is a local-storage-equipped instance within the ecs.i2 instance family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. The virtual machine provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 CPU configuration includes 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 33 MB L3 cache, with instruction set support including AVX, AVX-512F, AES, and BMI2. Hardware resources feature 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core allocation, coupled with 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage and a baseline network throughput of 1 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark assessments show performance metrics that align with older hardware platforms. In computational evaluations, the instance scored 934.0 on Geekbench single-core and 2030.0 on multi-core, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 3594.19 and stress-ng results of 1102.28 single-core and 2922.29 multi-core, placing overall CPU performance in the bottom quartile. Memory bandwidth testing recorded 19.71 GB/sec for large-block uncached reads and 18.31 GB/sec for uncached writes. Operational tests demonstrated 2.95 million operations per second in Redis SET commands, 2.4 GB/sec in static web serving throughput, and small 135M model LLM processing speeds of 227.1 prompt tokens per second and 56.18 generation tokens per second.

The primary resource advantage of the ecs.i2.xlarge is the inclusion of 959 GB of directly attached local SSD storage alongside an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. However, processing throughput and memory bandwidth remain constrained compared to modern compute platforms. The instance profile is suited for intermediate storage-intensive roles, caching layers, local data staging, and database testing where dedicated local disk capacity and memory volume take precedence over raw compute velocity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.xlarge is an x86_64 instance from the Local SSDs family, offering 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor at 2.5 GHz. The configuration includes 32.0 GB of RAM, a 959 GB local SSD, and a 1 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark measurements reflect modest computing power, registering a Geekbench single-core score of 934.0, a multi-core score of 2030.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 3594.19. Memory bandwidth reaches 19.71 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads, while Redis SET throughput achieves 2.95 million operations per second. The server integrates a generous 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio and bundled solid-state disk storage, balancing lower compute performance with dedicated storage capacity for operational databases, caching nodes, and local data-processing workloads.
